notices: Monitor settings for Web-based Manager access
Using wildcard characters when filtering log messages
Disk logging disabled by default on some models (Log to FortiCloud instead)
Upgrading from FortiOS v5.0 Patch Release 4 or later

observations.description: Resolved an issue that caused a time out when upgrading from FortiOS v5.0 build 228 to FortiOS v5.0 Patch Release 5.
Resolved an issue that blocked access to WAN Optimization storage after a fresh install of FortiOS 5.0 Patch Release 5 on FG-60C and FWF-60C-ADSL models.
Dynamic Profile configurations must be upgraded manually to RSSO when upgrading from FortiOS v4.0 MR3 to v5.0.
The Web-based Manager now displays an application sensor properly when the sensor contains an application that is not found in either the built-in or custom application database.
Bing video SafeSearch now works as expected.
The FWF-80CM supports 7 local radio SSIDs.
Improved HTTP header parsing when non-compliant line endings are used to mark the end of headers.
The correct virus name now appears in botnet detection logs.
DLP correctly detects social security or credit cards numbers in email subjects.
DLP correctly parses filenames in SMTP email.
The SSN and Credit card data field separation procedure used in DLP for docx files works correctly.
Link state synchronization operates correctly on content-cluster worker blades.
Resolved an issue that caused High CPU and connection acceptance issues with the SSL proxy.
Antivirus is correctly applied on HTTP PUT requests.
Resolved an issue that caused session clashes.
Resolved an issue that caused some VIPs to stop working after 30 to 60 minutes.
Resolved an issue that caused the Fortinet bar to stop refreshing web pages after a successful logout.
The transparent proxy now correctly handles 100 continue in POST method.
Resolved an issue that caused high CPU and connection acceptance issues with the SSL proxy.
Resolved an issue that caused Sflow traffic capture to show s incorrect frame lengths.
FortiOS properly stores the message sent by a server in response to a client's DATA request.
VIP addresses can be used for source NAT IPs when static VIPs and dynamic IP pools are combined and the VIP address as NAT source IP option is enabled.
Resolved an issue that caused 'SCCP connection to a.b.c.d:2000 failed' messages.
Resolved an issue that caused DLP file pattern extension match issues.
Resolved an issue that caused FTP to stall due with some special file patterns.
Resolved an issue that caused incorrect parsing of user names in the FTP proxy.
Support deep inspection of sites with very long certificate chains.
STARTTLS commands sent to a server are not modified by FortiOS.
Resolved an issue that caused the proxy worker to crash with signal 11 due to a stack overflow when FortiGuard web filtering is enabled.
Hairpin NAT now works correctly.
Resolved an issue that caused "msisdn-prefix" basic filtering to stop working in "imsi" configuration of GTP profiles.
Resolved an issue that caused GTP secondary context tear down problems when deleting primary context.
Resolved an issue that caused reloading the config file or a FortiGate restart to loose the set ovrd-scope-browser. setting.
Resolved an issue that caused the SSH key to remains on a LENC model after applying a license for full encryption.
FortiGate-3600C failover speed improved.
RTP session are kept alive in TCP SIP traffic after HA failover.
Resolved an issue that caused dedicated HA management interfaces to have the same virtual MAC on both cluster members after a failover.
Resolved an issue that caused upgrading cluster firmware from FortiOS 4.3 to fail and CPU usage on the primary unit to stay at 99%.
Traffic history now available for ipsec_phase1 and ipsec_manualkey interfaces in interface filter.
Resolved an issue that caused IPv6 packets of IPsec with AH header to dropped by FortiOS without recording a log message.
Resolved an issue that caused the iked daemon to crash when a dialup peer address was changed.
Resolved an issue that caused 'Peertype' and 'Peerid' to be removed from the IPsec VPN configuration after a reboot.
Resolved an issue that caused NAT64 to use the external interface as source NAT IP when the configuration included an IPPOOL.
Resolved an issue that removed web filtering information from traffic logs.
Log setting views now match after enabling Client Reputation.
Support NAT64 and NAT46 in compact v3 mode.
Resolved an issue that caused FortiOS to send fragmented compact v3 logs to FortiAnalyzer.
Resolved an issue that prevented log messages with custom traffic log fields from being sent to FortiAnalyzer.
Traffic log message show correct service when there are multi-customer defined services that have same protocol/port.
ICQ GUI setting and detected log have been corrected.
The msg field has been added to router logs (Log id 20063).
Log messages for SSL VPN tunnel traffic for both SSL VPN web and tunnel mode now include user names.
IPSec event logs now include the IPsec tunnel type.
Resolved an issue that prevented BGP over IPv6 neighbor with password set may from working.
Resolved an issue that prevented OSPF graceful restarts with multiple helpers.
Resolved an issue that caused the sslvpnd daemon to enter conserve mode.
Resolved an issue that prevented accessing RDP using SSL VPN web mode bookmarks.
An SSL VPN host check successfully logs explicitly failed host check messages for unsupported OS/Browsers.
SSL VPN parser works with the Dojo Toolkit.
Resolved an issue with the parsec that caused high CPU usage by the SSL VPN daemon.
Resolved an issue that caused memory corruption by jemalloc which resulted in SSL VPN sessions disconnecting intermittently.
Resolved an issue that caused the SSL VPN Web Mode Tunnel Widget to hang when connecting to OSX
SCP configuration restore command now consistent with backup command.
Resolved an issue that caused a fnbamd memory leak.
Resolved an issue where the NTP daemon tried to delete other sessions, including SSH and telnet sessions, instead of just NTP sessions.
Resolved an issue that caused the telnetd daemon to be left as a zombie because its parent process doesn't call wait() on the child process when child process exits.
Resolved an NPU switch chip issue that allowed multicast MAC addresses on FGT200D/240D/280DPOE
Resolved possible flash issues with ext2_write_inode: unable to read inode block preceded by "scanunit=child exittype=exit code=255" error message.
The MIB value fgProcessorPktDroppedCount is now calculated correctly.
Japanese characters in replacement messages are no longer garbled after rebooting.
The correct system time appears when the timezone is set to Rangoon.
Resolved an issue that prevented HA management pings from being sent through the correct interface.
Config pushed from FMG to FGT is no longer list after reboot.
SNMP information can be sent over dedicated management interfaces.
The RTSP helper no longer blocks the offload of a session using 7070/8554 as a source port.
LACP renegotiation is no longer required after transient interface failures.
LACP renegotiation is no longer required after transient interface failures.
Resolved an issue that caused an STP forwarding problem in one-arm Transparent mode firewalls.
Resolved an issue that caused the modem interface distance and priority to be overwritten at runtime and also during system boot.
Enable jumbo frames on FortiGate-60D/90D/200D internal interfaces.
Timezone for Mexico (Chihuahua) GMT7 added.
Resolved an issue that caused configuration backups to fail when any accprofile is named admin.
Resolved an issue that caused ICMP packets to be dropped by Nturbo enabled platforms.
Resolved an issue that prevented Huawei E169 from connecting due to 'PPP recv: IPCP Configure_Nak'
PPPoE interface addresses are correctly output by the SNMP IP MIB.
Gratuitous ARP going out from the wrong interface in Transparent mode.
Resolved an issue that prevented IPv6 allow access settings from working with some configurations.
Resolved an issue that prevented NP4 processors from forwarding traffic. Affected models: FortiGate-3040B, FMC-XD2, FortiGate-3240C.
VLAN interface statistics are supported on XLP interfaces.
Aggregate NPU session flushing improved.
Aggregate NPU session flushing improved.
Resolved an issue that caused dhcpd memory leaks.
Resolved an issue that caused the DSCP value to be set to 0 by switch chip on a FortiGate-100D VLAN interface.
HA fail over support restored when set lacp ha slave disable is used.
VDOM config restore correctly applies IPSec interface IPs.
Resolved an issue that caused the DNS proxy to crash because it tried to insert into an entry that was found early but was freed because max limit was reached.
Resolved an issue that caused NP4 interfaces on the FortiGate-800C to stop forwarding traffic periodically.
FortiGate-3600C power supply failure SNMP trap added.
Resolved an issue that caused trusted hosts to block traffic for other remote wildcard administrators.
Remote wildcard admin users with accprofile-override can now restore the configuration on a cluster from the CLI.
Resolved an issue that caused FWF-60CS-A PPPoA connections to go down after changing Allow Access settings on the ADSL interface.
Resolved an issue that caused an the error message “cli 38 die in an exception in line 1653” when upgrading from FortiOS 4 MR3 Patch 14 to FortiOS 5.0 MR5.
VDOM administrators restricted to certain VDOMs can no longer see all VDOM names from the CLI.
FTP proxy replacement messages with multiple lines are now displayed correctly by FTP clients.
Resolved an issue that caused a system crash when a property of a new session is not set correctly in the web-cache Transparent proxy.
Resolved an issue that caused WAN Optimization to crash with signal 6 while processing IPS and HTTPS requests.
Custom replacement message now load when Web caching is turned on in a policy.
MAPI memory leak issues resolved.
The traffic widget now displays data for PPPoE interfaces.
Interfaces added to zones are now listed under Local Outgoing.
Performance of system/interface DHCP reservation tables improved.
VLAN interfaces are now available when configuring a policy if the parent physical interface is in a zone.
Resolved issues that prevented the ability to create all to all multicast policies.
Thew firewall monitor now displays the correct traffic volume for authenticated users.
The option "Log Violation Traffic" can now be selected when creating a multicast policy.
Policy NAT64 does not use IPv6 pool validation when adding a new pool from the GUI.
Resolved an issue that caused some FortiAP radio interfaces to randomly stop working and display an INTF_DOWN message.
Added the correct country code and wireless settings for the Ukraine.

Resolved WiFi performance and packet loss issues with Realtek RTL8188CE wireless clients. New command to configure 802_11g protection mode: configure wireless-controller wtp-profile config radio-1 set protection-mode {ctsonly| disable | rtscts} end Where ctsonly enables 802.11g protection CTS only mode. disable disables 802.11g protection mode. rtscts enables 802.11g protection RTS/CTS mode.
Traffic may be interrupted if you have created two physical links between a managed FortiSwitch and a FortiGate acting as the manager but only configured one of the links as an aggregate link member.
observations.workaround: Remove one of the links or configure both of them.

observations.description: Application control does not always work as expected for HTTPS traffic over the explicit web proxy.
FortiGate units with NP4 processes running in Transparent Mode may experience a Transparent mode L2 loop when upgrading to FortiOS 5.0 Patch Release 6.
observations.workaround: Set the npu-vlink interface to be administratively down before upgrading to FortiOS 5.0 Patch 6. FortiOS 4.3 firmware does not support setting the npu-vlink interface down. In this case you should upgrade to a FortiOS 5.0 patch 4 and set the npu-vlink interface to be administratively down and then upgrade to FortiOS 5.0 Patch 6.
